cross_reactive_probes.tsv.gz: union of published cross-reactive (non-specific) probe lists
- Chen YA et al. (2013) Epigenetics 8:203-209 (450K, 29,233 probes)
- McCartney DL et al. (2016) Genomics Data 9:22-24, supplementary tables 1-2 (EPIC)
- Pidsley R et al. (2016) Genome Biology 17:208, additional file 1 (EPIC)
Obtained from the maxprobes repository (github.com/markgene/maxprobes, inst/extdata).
